Garchomp and Dragapult provide fast Dragon-type pressure, Corviknight and Toxapex anchor the defensive side with Steel/Poison/Water bulk, while Gholdengo and Quaquaval add Electric/Fighting coverage and pivot utility to hit different types across any three-Pokémon lineup.

The EVs are split 32/32/2 to maximize two relevant stats within the 66-point cap, and natures are chosen to support each Pokémon's role without wasting points on irrelevant stats.
